status: implementation contract / peer transport activation gated
purpose: Bind content-addressed data transfer and delegated computation to existing CGX identity, execution leases, receipts and readback without creating a second runtime or transferring semantic authority.
identity_rules: node identity is distinct from agent identity and semantic authority
surface identity is not node identity
storage volume or carrier is not an independent compute node unless compute capability and independent process identity are proven
node capability claims require current readback evidence
transfer_rules: source bytes remain authoritative until exact target readback verifies the same sha256 and size
copy or transport never transfers semantic, governance or release authority
target mutation requires DIGITAL_WRITE or stronger lease when execution is requested
existing identical payload may be reused without byte-for-byte retransmission
existing non-identical target is a conflict and must not be overwritten silently
partial transfer remains staging only and cannot satisfy downstream compute dependency
verified transfer receipt is operational evidence, not canonical promotion
compute_rules: delegated compute requires COMPUTE_ONLY or stronger current scoped execution lease
compute request may reference transferred inputs only after verified target readback
raw instruction is transport context and is not semantic authority
arbitrary shell execution is not a node capability
executor must be a registered deterministic tool, solver, simulation capability or existing Cognigrex/LightSpeed workflow
resource budget is a ceiling and heavy execution remains separately gated
result values remain unknown until receipted execution
compute receipt must identify node, capability, input manifest hash, result refs and execution provenance
compute output does not authorise canonical promotion, provider writes, publication or actuation
receipt_rules: Task_ID and Run_ID lineage is preserved across transfer and compute
source and destination hashes are retained

critical_separations: Capacity metric is not security classification; grid apparent power (MVA) is not electrical capacitance (F).
3-of-5 observational agreement is not 3-of-5 threshold recovery, geometric observability, causal identification or cryptographic authentication.
Nine semantic views do not encode nine independent new state measurements.
No data is recoverable solely from the absence of an instrumented storage/channel.
Discovery of government/utility infrastructure does not confer owner permission, rights to use RF carriers or national emergency authority.
Public identity must identify independent Australian origin, not purport to represent Australia or any agency.
LLM interpretation is optional and evidence-attributed; local deterministic safety/OT remains independent.
State reconstruction is non-authoritative until current cryptographic transport, lease, readback, source and owner gates pass.

hydration_and_fract_key_contract.status: review-contract / additive mapping inside existing FileSpace and node_exchange
hydration_and_fract_key_contract.hydration_owner: Cognigrex.cgx FileSpace identity/roots; child semantic owners retain meaning; node_exchange transports only admitted fragments
hydration_and_fract_key_contract.progressive_rule: RAW INTENT -> resolve security/authority -> H0 identity -> hydrate only missing H1..H9 discriminants -> resolve/project/execute under existing gate -> readback -> receipt -> retain remaining HOLD/UNKNOWN.

fract_key.name: Fract Key Code
fract_key.meaning: Deterministic non-secret locator for one source-bound fragment/facet at one hydration plane. 'Fract' means fragment/facet addressing shorthand here; it does not assert mathematical fractal structure.
invariants: FKC is an alias/locator, never a replacement Object_ID, DBR root, state root, cryptographic key, credential, lease or authority token.
Same source fragment may have several FKC projections across planes/lenses; all retain the same owning Object_ID and revision/root lineage.
FKC digest equality only proves equality of canonical locator fields, not equality of underlying bytes unless H1 source hash/readback also matches.
Private/root fingerprints are not exposed through public projections; public releases use separately approved projection identifiers.
morton3_chunk is permitted only as an optional H1/H2 geometric byte address when an exact source/chunk root and decoder are already verified.
Legacy random fractal visualisation modules are not FKC authority, key derivation or hydration logic.

scatter_gather.scatter_definition: Distribute references or authorised fragment bytes to selected layers/nodes/lenses without copying semantic authority.
scatter_gather.gather_definition: Recompose only when required FKC records, source/profile/prior roots, sequence and permissions reconcile; otherwise HOLD/CONFLICT/NOT_CACHED.
prohibited_collapses: layer count == node count == lens count
three matching labels == three independent witnesses
scatter_gather.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN, NOT_CACHED, WITHHELD and ZERO are distinct states and must never be collapsed during scatter/gather.

layer_mapping.H3_SEMANTICS: Registered type/unit/dictionary/equation semantics under source evidence ceiling.
layer_mapping.H4_RELATIONS: Typed dependency/cross-domain/invalidation edges by stable reference.
layer_mapping.H6_STATE: DataSpace profile/prior/result roots, sparse delta, DBR/history/conflict lineage.
layer_mapping.H7_CAPABILITY: node/root registry, declared adapter/model/transport/renderer/compute capability and lease state.
layer_mapping.H8_EXECUTION: Existing transfer/compute/queue action packet and exact readback/receipt.
layer_mapping.H9_WITNESS: PrintSpace/empirical/provider/professional witness references only after real receipt; never synthesized by node_exchange.
